details: signup-lib@99.99.99 is a dependency-confusion package: it takes the unscoped name of an internal dependency, which its `source.txt` says was found in a published JavaScript source map, and uses version 99.99.99 to win over the private package. A `postinstall` hook runs `node postinstall.js` on npm install, which prints a notice to stderr and sends the machine's hostname to `https://h1.cx/log?depconf=<hostname>` with an HTTPS GET. The package calls itself an authorized security-research canary, but it reports from any machine that installs it without the installer's consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: Executed by the postinstall script of signup-lib@99.99.99.
